_comment: Merge this 'hooks' block into ~/.claude/settings.json (Claude Code). It drives the duckyPad status LEDs on session lifecycle events. All hooks are async (never block your session) and always exit 0. Adjust the script path if you don't clone Raft to this location. The same command works for both hosts: duckypad_hook.py detects cmux vs Orca from the firing session's own environment (set RAFT_HOST=cmux|orca|off to override). On cmux it sets one key, the firing session's own. On Orca every event repaints all five keys from 'orca worktree ps', so keys track agents that never fire a Claude hook (Codex, Gemini). Note: interrupting a turn fires NO hook, so on cmux an interrupted session stays 'working' until your next prompt; on Orca the next event from any session corrects it. If you also use Orca, it installs its own hook as a sibling entry here — see docs/calibration.md 'After an Orca upgrade'.
